lede: Stanford carries the stronger underlying team rating — +0.2 against -1.4, a 1.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Duke -16.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Duke winning 85% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is receivers, where Duke leads Stanford by 60 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
